# Rrita Canolli
AI Developer, Product Builder, and Youth Innovator based in Prishtina, Kosovo.

Rrita Canolli is a 15-year-old AI developer specializing in LLM-based systems, automation, and product design, with 15+ deployed AI agents, a Junction Global Hackathon qualification, and leadership experience across international programs.

## Core Achievements
- 1st Place (Domain) and 2nd Overall – Junction X Tirana 2024
- Golden Ticket Winner – Junction Global Hackathon Finals (Helsinki, 48h challenge)
- 1st Place in Balkans – Programming Competition (AI Culture project)
- EU eTwinning Winner – EcoVoice Kosova (AI-powered recycling system)
- T* Award at Astra Nova (2 out of 350 students)
- Member of Mensa International (Top 2% cognitive ability globally)
- 2nd in Kosovo – Cognitive Ability Olympiad (CogAT XCEL)
- 1500+ hours in creative production and design

## Experience
### Primex Sh.P.K. – AI Team (2022–Present)
- Built and deployed 15+ AI agents and automation systems for real business clients
- Designed AI workflows for operations, analytics, and customer interaction
- Worked on AI integration for the furniture industry using data-driven systems

### Shkolla Digjitale – AI Intern (2024–2025)
- Developed a personalized AI learning platform for students
- Built chatbot systems and adaptive learning tools
- Continued across two summers due to performance
